correctness.rationale: Theorem 6.2 reduces the free-product norm to the least midpoint height of an affine majorant of the continuous slice profile. Every affine majorant dominates the least concave majorant, while a supporting affine line at the midpoint gives equality. The one-dimensional concave envelope is the supremum of barycentric averages with midpoint barycenter, and two support points suffice; continuity gives attainment. Canonical-factor and constant-function checks agree with the source norm.
